reason: SCHEDULE/FEASIBILITY lens: refuted. Calendar time is not the problem: a clean run scores by 26 Sep ~16-20 UTC and leaves ~60 h of buffer. What sinks it is a chain of unresolved gates, which puts P(scored probe of THE IDEA AS DESCRIBED before 29 Sep 10:00 UTC) at ~0.3-0.4, below the 0.7 bar. (1) The model's compatibility and licence are unknown and cannot be checked from here. load_model (tools/repo/scripts/predict_unet_transformer.py l.164-200) needs config.json next to the weights, a plain UNetNodeTransformer state_dict, strict loading and weights_only=True. leonixis/biohub-v5-candidates is described only as 'per-epoch checkpoints ... warm start from v3res; LB checkpoint-pick set' (research/browser_research_2026-09-24_pass2.md l.77). Training checkpoints often wrap model and optimizer state, 'v3res' may be a residual variant, and which epoch scored 0.947 is unknown. BROWSER_TODO #16 is still open and a web search found nothing. My guess is P(licence acceptable AND loadable with <= 0.5 h shim) ~0.5. The fallback (friend_a_full199_ep21, already in vitaliineibauer/biohub-ft-weights per exp27 kernel-metadata) is loadable, but it is the model that scored 0.920 as a secondary (experiments/RESULTS.md l.46). That is the closed 'weaker model in the blend' line, not the idea's 'independently trained, equally good model'. (2) New code is needed. build_probe_kernel.py --base x138 supports only divinsert/leafprune (l.12-16). The third-model blend must be a new string patch applied on top of x138's dual-seed patch and retention-guard patch (x138 cell 4 l.61-165): new loader env vars, a third model passed through predict_video's signature, 4-view TTA, alignment, a 3-way blend inside the guard block, and a guard log. This container can test only string-match plus compile (no torch installed, no data, no GPU), so the first real execution is the Kaggle dummy run. Estimate ~3 h agent work, and P(dummy passes node +-1.5% and guard-fallback < 5% on the first try) ~0.7 (guess). (3) Runtime interacts with the repair deadline. P and S each run 8 encodes per window, so T at 4 views adds +25% detection encodes (x138 cell 4). Comparable stacks score in 7.0-7.8 h (RESULTS.md, probes 28-33). x138 runs all repair AFTER all prediction, behind REPAIR_DEADLINE_S=27000 (7.5 h; see the budget schedule verdict). So +0.5-1.2 h of GPU phase (guess) would degrade relink/gap-fill/safe-div/linefit on a large share of datasets and confound the probe toward a false negative. The idea's cure, 'idea 1', was itself refuted as described (its all-or-nothing rule). The working substitute is --set REPAIR_DEADLINE_S=34200, which puts the total at ~9-10 h (guess) against a hard 12 h, with no dummy-based runtime projection because dummy runtime varies 1.5x between identical-compute runs (exp51 29 min vs exp52 43 min). Gate (c) as written ('projected hidden runtime from the dummy log < 10 h') is therefore unreliable, and P(timeout or crash on the hidden run) ~0.1 (guess). A retry fits in the buffer. (4) It depends on the base. #34 (x138 verbatim) scores only ~17-20 UTC today, and if it is not ~0.953 the patch targets the wrong base. (5) Slots and priority. The sibling value verdict puts E[gain] ~0, and every past detector-blend change was negative (0.8->0.5 -0.002, exp08 -0.016, exp23 -0.007, friend A -0.025; imissher: own-model secondary 0.939, weight 0.65 0.945), so the user may reasonably not spend one of the 20 slots on it. Product: 0.5 x 0.7 x 0.95 ~0.33 before the user's slot decision, so this is infeasible at >= 70%. The as-described implementation is also partly impossible: it 'must ship with the budget-aware guard (idea 1)', which is defective as written.
fix_if_any: Make it a gated, cheap rider with a hard kill date instead of a dedicated line. (a) Today (25 Sep, local session with Kaggle CLI + Chrome, 0.3 h): `kaggle datasets files leonixis/biohub-v5-candidates` plus download of ONE checkpoint and config.json. Check the licence (must be CC0/Apache/MIT-type; 'unknown' = kill), the keys (plain state_dict vs wrapped), config keys (unet_out_channels, unet_layers, window_size=2, downsample=[1,4,4]), and which epoch leonixis labels as LB-picked. If any of these fails, KILL the idea. Do not fall back to friend A's ep21 model (closed line). (b) Only if (a) passes, agent-container 3 h on 25 Sep evening: add `--patch thirddet` to tools/build_probe_kernel.py for --base x138. Env BIOHUB_THIRD_WEIGHTS / BIOHUB_THIRD_DETECTION_WEIGHT=0.2 / BIOHUB_THIRD_TTA_VIEWS=4. Load via load_model plus a state-dict unwrap shim, assert the same window/downsample, align T to the primary with the same mean/std rule, set det = 0.2P + 0.6S_aligned + 0.2T_aligned inside the existing guard block, and log `THIRDDET_STATS`. When the weight is 0, the output must be byte-identical to exp56 (test: the patched script with weight 0 must be text-identical in the blend path, plus compile). pip-install CPU torch and run one forward with random weights at tiny shape to catch shape/signature bugs. Always ship --set REPAIR_DEADLINE_S=34200 (the fixed-deadline repair of 'idea 1'), and ALSO build a control with only that --set, so the comparison is one change. (c) Replace gate (c) with a per-window timing ratio from the dummy log (GPU seconds per window with T / without T, measured in the same run by logging both), not wall-clock projection. Kill if the GPU-phase ratio is > 1.30. (d) Hard kill: if not submitted by 27 Sep 12:00 UTC, drop it. It must not compete with higher-EV ideas for the 28-29 Sep slots.
